objective: Measure the current ANVIL temporal-reconstruction pipeline against the decoded-frame control before outside candidates compete: does temporal accumulation provide measurable and visible improvement, and where does it degrade or accomplish nothing?

targets.note: 46 input frames per scene; targets 2..43 keep a full past=2/future=2 window for every target frame

arms.purpose: Decoded-frame control: same input, temporal accumulation disabled, normal output/color processing retained
Frozen canonical ANVIL baseline: exact default stage modes with a live temporal window
First evaluation of the existing configurable refinement and confidence stages with all otherwise-equivalent settings
Adds estimated sample geometry; whether valid geometry estimates were obtained is recorded, never fabricated

reference_run.purpose: Clean LR input through the identical decode/color/output path with accumulation disabled: representation-matched full reference for native-resolution metrics

delivery.note: Spatial delivery evaluation is separate from temporal reconstruction; each arm's native output is upscaled identically and compared against the HR master

expected_display_names.tryout_refinement_confidence: ANVIL baseline + local refinement + estimated confidence — tryout
expected_display_names.tryout_refinement_confidence_geometry: ANVIL baseline + local refinement + estimated confidence + estimated geometry — tryout
